source.source_title: Overview of the 2009 and 2010 ISO Transmission Plans
source.scope_note: This May 2009 CAISO presentation lists 14 renewable-related 2008 Request Window proposals. It is not the unavailable final 2009 CAISO Transmission Plan. Slide 11 says its locations are high-level and approximate, do not depict actual routes or detailed configurations, and the proposals still require further ISO evaluation.
